hero.subtitle: One bite. One sip. One story.

about.title: About Boliviana
about.intro: Die Seele Boliviens, Caraya Coffee, and Miskisimi — three Bolivian brands, one café in the heart of Berlin.
about.lead: A little piece of Bolivia in Berlin — told through food, coffee, wine, and the people behind them.
about.story: For years, August 6th — Bolivia's Independence Day — brought us together at Winsstraße 17 for pop-up celebrations of Bolivian food, coffee, wine, and culture. Die Seele Boliviens was already running a ghost kitchen next door, making handmade salteñas and pastries, and the space gradually became a meeting point for friends, collaborators, and the Bolivian community in Berlin. When the previous café owners decided to close, the opportunity arose to turn that spirit into something permanent. Ann and Sergio took it — bringing together Caraya's Bolivian specialty coffee and Die Seele Boliviens' food under one roof. And Boliviana was born: a place for Bolivians missing home and for everyone curious to discover the country's food, coffee, wine, and culture.
about.storyDetail: Today, Die Seele Boliviens still hand-folds every salteña the traditional way — a golden pastry filled with a rich, juicy stew you sip before taking the first bite. Caraya works directly with growers from Asocafé Bolivia, roasting single-origin coffees that change with the season and are largely produced by women. Wine and Singani are part of the story too. Through a long-standing collaboration with MiskiSimi, a specialist importer bringing Bolivian wines and spirits to Europe, Boliviana showcases wines from the high-altitude vineyards of Tarija and Cinti alongside Singani, Bolivia's distinctive national spirit and the heart of a proper Chuflay. Different crafts and stories, brought together by the same love for Bolivia — right here in Berlin.

miskisimi.name: MiskiSimi
miskisimi.blurb: Bolivian wine & Singani — bringing the diversity of Bolivia's high-altitude vineyards and its distinctive national spirit to Europe, with a focus on distinctive producers, unique origins and wines with a story to tell.
